heading: GO / NO-GO: three criteria, all must hold

criteria.name: Expressed
criteria.met_when: GTEx median TPM ≥ 1 in the run's region (fallback: tissue-distribution ring > 0 if GTEx is absent)
criteria.source: GTEx median TPM, Open Targets prioritisation

criteria.name: Phenotype in a study
criteria.met_when: mouse-KO ring > 0, or ≥ 1 abnormal mouse phenotype term(s)

go: GO when all three are met.
no_go: NO-GO when any one is not met.
insufficient: INSUFFICIENT DATA when none is not met but any is no data.
never_a_criterion: Druggability, safety and pipeline never change the verdict.
